jobs_results.title: Software Engineer, Ingeniero de Software, DevOps
jobs_results.description:
Location: Sanz

Software Engineer

Department: Development - Software Development

Employment Type: Permanent - Full Time

Location: Spain

Reporting To: Yana Rolnik
Description

Remote Spain

Why Confluence?

Over the past several years we have undergone a great deal of positive change and growth to become the company we are today. Our global footprint now spans multiple countries, giving our employees the opportunity to get exposure to other countries and cultures. And it stands to reason that none of this would have been possible without the hundreds of hard-working employees who work at Confluence.
More about the role & team

Alongside working with new technologies, on a new product, the team is international, based across primarily the US and Spain.

You will collaborate locally with UI and Backend developers, with the wider project team, and the QA team based across multiple locations.

You will be one of a few Back-end Software Engineers working on a key project, amalgamating 2... important regulatory reporting products together into one platform.
What skills and experience do I need to succeed?

You will have extensive experience in .NET development, Mongo

DB, and Microsoft Azure (or another Cloud based product such as AWS).

You will also possess a strong understanding of microservices architecture and be proficient in Docker and Kubernetes (A plus).

You must have a good standard of written and spoken English language.

You may have worked as a ‘Software Engineer’, 'Senior Software Engineer’, 'Back-end Developer' or 'Software Developer'.
What do we offer?

Confluence offers generous benefit packages for team members. As a growing, global organization, we are always looking for ways to ensure that our employees can access benefits that matter to them and their families. This includes:

Generous Time Off packages including additional half days with each public holiday in your location.

Global Career Development opportunities

Social Events

Referral Bonus scheme - Upto $3,000 per successful referral

Plus many more!

More about the Location

We offer flexible working options for all employees. Although we have a location in Valencia, we can accommodate remote working anywhere in mainland Spain.

#LI-Remote

Values

We look for people who align with our 4 values.

Integrity

Face reality with honesty, courage and accountability

Imagination

Deal creatively with challenges and envision what the world could be

Discipline

Build good habits into reflexes which become a part of our life

Service

Committed to the success of others

If you would like to find out more about a Career at Confluence, please apply today.

Please submit your CV in English for consideration.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
duagon Iberia, a rapidly expanding Swiss technology company, is a leading supplier for communication, computing and control technology as well as project planning and development services for system critical applications in the rail, medical and critical automation market. The superior software and hardware IP creates innovative, highly reliable and safe products, enabling customers to shape and realize their technology roadmap. Moreover, customers benefit from a shorter time to market and lower total cost of ownership.

Desde duagon Iberia estamos ampliando nuestro equipo, precisamos incorporar un Programador Java para participar en nuestros proyectos en el sector ferroviario.

Modalidad: 100% remoto

Conocimientos:
• Licenciado en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones o afines.
• Alrededor de 7 años de experiencia.
• Experiencia previa trabajando con Java.
• Experiencia previa en docker y kubernetes.
• Haber trabajado previamente en CI/CD.

Qué ofrecemos:
• Contrato indefinido... con un paquete importante de salario flexible (tickets restaurante, cheque guardería, seguro médico…)
• Modalidad híbrida.
• Flexibilidad horaria y laboral.
• Carrera profesional con oportunidades de promoción.
• Formación continua
• Actividades de Team building (BBQ, torneos de pádel…)
• Vacaciones: 23 días laborales.

En duagon Iberia podrás desarrollar tu carrera en función de tus aspiraciones, crecer con nosotros y participar en nuestras interesantes iniciativas de conciliación mediante la modalidad híbrida de trabajo, formación continua y remuneración atractiva.

Si quieres saber más, visítanos en www.duagon.com

¡Únete a nuestro equipo

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer, Ingeniero de Software, Desarrollador Senior
jobs_results.description:
Worldsensing products have been pioneering the industrial IoT since 2008. We’re looking for a stand-out Software Engineer to join the Engineering department in our Barcelona office.

About Worldsensing

Founded in 2008, Worldsensing works with more than 300 engineering partners worldwide to improve geotechnical, geospatial and structural monitoring in mining, construction, rail and critical infrastructure management.

With over 1,000 monitoring networks deployed worldwide and connecting over 65,000 sensors to the Internet of Things, our Load sensing solution is the leader in the IoT remote monitoring space.

The Load sensing monitoring solution includes best-in-class edge devices and LoRa-based connectivity products. We also join forces with key industry players to offer software applications and solutions which engineering service providers use to add value to end customers.

The Mission:

The Software Engineer is a critical role in World Sensing. This role’s primary focus is the... development, definition, and deployment of software solutions for our products, whilst ensuring high performance and responsiveness to requests from and to these products.

Responsibilities:
• Design, development, and delivery of the company’s core platform and cloud applications, making sure our applications function properly (including scalability, efficiency, resilience, fault tolerance, and data security techniques).
• Work closely with other engineers & designers, product owners, and other team members to implement complex end-to-end systems.
• Use technical skills to close the gaps between new requirements and Worldsensing products.
• Build reusable code and libraries for future use.
• Rigorous commitment to documentation, quality engineering, testing, and support.
• Perform code reviews for other software engineers and provide feedback.
• On-call support may be required to support a 24/7 online service.
• Collaborate and help in the definition of European Union Innovation projects.
• 5+ years of software development experience in back-end services.
• 3+ years with Python using FastAPI framework.
• Experience with Java, React and Type Script is a plus.
• Experience with advanced programming frameworks and paradigms.
• Good experience with Linux environments.
• Experience with Docker.
• Experience with Kubernetes is a plus.
• Basic networking knowledge.
• Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, preferably Git.
• You're passionate about IoT & technical challenges. There should be something you know more about than anyone on our team.
• Strong analysis and practical problem-solving abilities to resolve challenging situations.
• You communicate with clarity and precision. We care about this almost as much as your technical ability.
• You’re an empathetic person who is comfortable with changes and is an incredibly fast learner and has a can-do, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude.
• BS degree in a technical field or equivalent experience.
• A good level of spoken and written English is required.

Competencies:
• Be able to develop in different programming languages.
• Ability to organize work with little day-to-day direction.
• Track record of flexibility in response to changing circumstances.
• A good team player with excellent verbal and written skills along with a strong commercial focus.
• A can-do, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude.
• Passion for your work and a sense of humor.
• Great work environment: we are a passionate, tight-knit team hailing from 20+ countries
• We are a family-friendly company and support a healthy work-life balance, we’re outcome oriented
• Work-from-home policy (flexibility)
• We like grabbing lunch or a drink together, and coming together for fun events organized by Worldsensing
• We love to learn and we love to share so you will actively participate in our knowledge sharing initiatives or transversal committees (communities, show and tell, etc.)
• You can expect a competitive compensation package
• Opportunity to work for a global IoT player which has been labeled as one of the organizations actively shaping and pioneering the Industrial Internet
• Hybrid working environment

At Worldsensing, we’re committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We strive to be a more equal opportunity workplace.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer, Ingeniero de Software, Java
jobs_results.description:
Posición: Staff Software Engineer
Location: Sanz

Vonage Engineering Mission: Vonage is the emerging leader in the $100B+ cloud communications platform (CPaaS) market. Customers like Airbnb, Viber, Whatsapp, Snapchat, and many others depend on our APIs and SDKs to connect with their customers all over the world.

As businesses continue to shift to a real-time, customer-centric communications model, we are experiencing a time of impressive growth.

Why this role matters

The Engineering team at Vonage is a fast growing group of talented engineers. They face multiple challenges associated with high performance, distributed systems, and processing large volumes of data in real time.

We are looking for a Staff Software Architect to help us develop a best in class real time platform for new Mobile Network based APIs such as Quality On Demand (QoD) or Silent Authentication.

What you will do
• Design and build software systems to add features and capabilities to our Global Network... Platform
• Create scalable systems using microservices that will help support our growth
• Write efficient, maintainable and well structured code, including multiple levels of testing
• Deploy into cloud infrastructure using IaaC
• Mentor more junior members of the engineering team
• Liaise with other parts of the business and other architects to ensure our Global Network Platform contributes to the vision of Vonage

What we value
• Being disruptive and getting things done with other smart people, enjoying knowing that the work we do is having a global impact by enabling never before imagined ways of communicating.
• We have big goals, and we want the people who join us to be self-confident, focused on customers and delivery, and who are structured and committed in their approach. We iterate quickly, we fail fast, we take smart chances, we value those who will help us continue this spirit.
• Values matter at Vonage, we are on a mission to bring value for consumers and enterprises through global cloud based communications.
• But just as important as delivering value is how we deliver that value.
• We believe in integrity, both personally and professionally, we believe in empowering our employees and are actively seeking entrepreneurs in training who want to help build something larger.
• We have gotten to this point by being committed, passionate, and focused on getting things done, we need more people like us; if this appeals to you then we encourage you to apply.

The Stack
• Java/Kotlin with Micronaut/Spring Boot
• AWS
• Kafka, Redis and Dynamo Db
• Reactive Programming (Reactor) and Kotlin Coroutines
• Anything needed to achieve our goals

What you will bring:
• Excellent software engineering skills in Java (and ideally Kotlin)
• An excellent practical understanding of high performance, highly distributed computing
• A strong focus on testing
• An understanding of Object Oriented Design, preferring composition over inheritance, and standard design patterns.
• Experience of multi-threaded, 3-tier architectures, web services and caching, preferring immutable objects to assist in reasoning in these complex environments.

The Engineering team at Vonage is a fast growing group of talented engineers. They face multiple challenges associated with high performance, distributed systems, and processing large volumes of data in real time.

We are looking for a Staff Software Architect to help us develop a best in class real time platform for new Mobile Network based APIs such as Quality On Demand (QoD) or Silent Authentication.

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer (Android) (m/f/d)
jobs_results.description:
Diabetes is a pesky monster — and that’s putting it mildly. If you’re serious about helping us face it head on, come join us!

Always driven by our motto to “make diabetes suck less,” we develop award-winning apps, integrate medical devices into our products, and work with health insurance companies and industry partners to make life with diabetes a bit better. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out our Monster Culture blog to see what makes mySugr & Roche tick.

Developing mobile apps is great, but developing mobile apps with a purpose is even better! As a Software Engineer at Roche, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of developers, designers, product owners, and QA experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software development practices on a daily basis and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users' lives at risk!

Here’s what we’re looking for:

We’re... looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Android) who will have a significant impact on the software development process and moving your entire team forward. Your main contribution will be writing code while acting as a role model for the entire development team. You apply your experience in architectural and technical decision making, ensuring a high code quality and contribute your technical knowledge as a foundation for strategic product decisions, identifying and driving improvements of the product development process and its infrastructure.

Your upcoming mission:
• You have at least 5 years of experience working as a Software Engineer (Android) with good knowledge of Kotlin
• You have a degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent technical knowledge
• You are well acquainted with the Android platform and APIs
• You have a passion for clean code and solid, future-proof architectures and you have testing in mind while you develop production code
• You are able and open to learn new technologies and processes
• You love working in and supporting an interdisciplinary team, together with developers, QAs, designers, and product owners
• You enjoy guiding and sharing your knowledge with other developers
• Great written and verbal communication in English, including technical terminology

What you will be working with:
• We are always trying to stay on top of the game and use modern tools and approaches standardized across the industry.
• Our codebase is Kotlin-first with usage of Dagger, Coroutines, reactive programming with Flows, Material design, ViewModel architecture and more
• Unit tests and continuous integration is an important and integral part of our development process. We know there is no excuse not to write tests and the only way to go fast is to go well
• You will learn about the wide range of technologies we employ, gaining a rich understanding of the specific requirements of medical software, be it security, medical risk management, safe and resilient programming, or certifications and audits

Bonus Skills:
• Understanding of medical, security, and privacy regulations
• Knowledge of the diabetes industry or other comparable health industries

Here's what you can expect from us:
• Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products
• An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams
• We welcome technical evangelists, so if you are interested in any thought leadership contributions (blogs, conferences) within the realm of the organization, we are happy to support you.

You will learn about the wide range of technologies we employ, from native mobile development to infrastructure-as-code in our cloud environment, gaining a rich understanding of the specific requirements of medical software, be it security, medical risk management, safe and resilient programming, or certifications and audits.

You will have direct contact with our users, learning about their daily struggles living with diabetes, as well as customers and partners, understanding the unique needs and mechanics of healthcare systems worldwide.

Interested? Great. We’d like to hear from you! Just click that “Apply Now” button and send us your CV… and anything else you think might impress us.

Make sure to read our Privacy Notice for Applicants.

Who we are

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero/a de Software Embebido (Linux)
jobs_results.description:
Tras 20 años de operación bajo la marca GPTech, eks Energy continúa con la vocación de ser referente, a nivel global, en la transformación energética necesaria para crear un futuro respetuoso con el medioambiente y justo en el reparto de los recursos energéticos.

Proporcionamos soluciones para integración de energías renovables y sistemas de almacenamiento, basadas en electrónica de potencia y sistemas avanzados de control. Trabajamos tanto en grandes plantas de generación, como a nivel comercial e industrial, con soluciones adaptadas a las necesidades del cliente. Acompañamos a nuestros clientes en todo el ciclo de vida del producto, desde el estudio y planteamiento inicial de la instalación hasta la asistencia técnica post venta, con servicio en los cinco continentes.

A finales del pasado año, nuestra empresa dio además un paso significativo al entrar a formar parte de Hitachi Energy, líder tecnológico global en el avance hacia un futuro energético sostenible. Esta integración... refleja nuestro compromiso con la excelencia y la innovación, consolidando nuestra posición como un actor clave en la transformación hacia un mundo más sostenible y energéticamente eficiente.

Nuestras oficinas centrales se sitúan en Bollullos de la Mitación (Sevilla), donde está ubicado nuestro centro de desarrollo. En estos momentos apostamos por priorizar el teletrabajo y la flexibilidad laboral, permitiendo a nuestros empleados la conciliación de vida laboral y personal. En nuestra empresa podemos estar orgullosos además de gozar de buen ambiente de trabajo.

eks Energy es, además, una organización plenamente comprometida con la igualdad de oportunidades.

Nuestro equipo, es el principal generador de valor ¿te gustaría unirte?

En la actualidad estamos ampliando nuestro equipo dentro del área Técnica de la compañía, en búsqueda de un perfil de Ingeniero/a de Software Embebido (Linux).

Nuestros equipo de I+D desarrolla tecnologías innovadoras que cambian la forma en que funciona el mundo y las industrias hacen negocios. Superamos constantemente los límites de lo convencional, mientras mantenemos nuestro enfoque en ofrecer productos y soluciones de calidad a nuestros clientes.

El equipo de Innovación y Desarrollo de Productos está establecido en Sevilla. Como parte de este equipo, trabajará en un equipo multifuncional de ingenieros altamente cualificados formado por perfiles de electrónica de potencia, sistemas de control, firmware, software, hardware, test & validación e sistemas mecánicos. Desarrollará nuevas plataformas innovadoras de convertidores modulares para una variedad de aplicaciones de conexión a red y sistemas de corriente continua. Se espera que supere los límites de la tecnología en términos de eficiencia, tamaño y rendimiento operativo. Si estás listo para el desafío, únete a nosotros.

Funciones
• Desarrollarás software en Linux para sistemas embebidos.
• Desarrollo de aplicaciones de espacio de usuario Linux usando C.
• Realizarás la especificación y desarrollo de comunicaciones IP tanto con sockets como con protocolos de más alto nivel
• Realizarás pruebas del software embebido para tener entornos estables.
• Gestionarás la generación de versiones del software embebido
• Despliegue y mantenimiento de aplicaciones en la nube y actualizaciones de dispositivos.
• Soporte técnico a otras áreas y departamentos.
• Elaboración de documentación técnica.
• Cumplimiento del Plan de Calidad del Área SW (QoS)

Requisitos necesarios
• Formación superior en Ingeniería.
• Experiencia con sistema operativo Linux a nivel usuario y administrador, preferiblemente en equipos embebidos.
• Experiencia en programación C, C++ y Python
• Conocimientos en aquitectura de procesadores, redes, ciberseguridad y los sistemas interconectados.
• Buen conocimiento de scripting y herramientas para automatización de sistemas
• Conocimiento/desarrollo del boot y el kernel de Linux.
• Conocimiento/desarrollo de drivers para el kernel de Linux.
• Experiencia en desarrollo de firmware embebido con RTOS
• Manejo de herramientas de administración y gestión de contenedores como Docker

Requisito deseable:
• +5 años de experiencia relevante en los requisitos solicitados.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Contratación indefinida
• Desarrollo profesional
• Flexibilidad horaria
• Atractivo programa de beneficios sociales tanto para ti como para tu familia
• Incorporarte a un equipo humano de reconocido prestigio, dentro de una organización donde el capital humano es primordial y en la que tendrás la oportunidad de desarrollarte profesionalmente
